scope: synthetic-only qualification of v3.1 ID-keyed selected-routing-weight enclosures

semantics.selected_set_precondition: eight unique expert IDs and selected-set invariance independently proven
semantics.probability_source: pre-bias sigmoid probability; correction bias is selection-only

protected_properties.enclosure_validity: nominal ID-keyed weight is finite, strictly positive, and contained in a finite strictly-positive outward v3.1 interval
protected_properties.identity_stability: selected-set invariance is a prerequisite and is not re-proven by this contract
protected_properties.coefficient_perturbation: every admissible routing weight remains within the inherited R10 per-weight maximum-absolute-error budget
protected_properties.aggregate_output: not discharged by weight qualification; later M1-F must still satisfy accumulation and complete-layer numerical contracts

mathematical_acceptance.overall_pass: all eight per-ID passes and joint shared-denominator normalization validation passes
mathematical_acceptance.relative_width_rule: none; relative radius is diagnostic only

engineering_acceptance.overall_pass: mathematical overall pass and all eight per-ID engineering passes

joint_normalization.probability_sum: P=sum_{k in T}(p_k) with outward interval reduction
joint_normalization.dependency_rule: derive the joint sum from the common P interval; never sum independently extremized q_i endpoints
joint_normalization.floor_inactive: joint mathematical sum is 2.5 with one outward binary64 transport neighbor
joint_normalization.floor_transition: propagate the same monotone piecewise expression across the floor
joint_normalization.required_check: joint sum interval contains the nominal selected-weight sum
joint_normalization.additional_aggregate_width_threshold: none; no pre-existing expert-output norm budget authorizes one

fail_closed_conditions: not exactly eight unique in-range expert IDs
missing or extra ID-keyed probability or weight field
interval not derived by or identity-bound to frozen routing-contract v3.1
attempt to use this contract as complete-layer or candidate qualification
